LanguageData.LP_FeatGrowth.label: quicken growth
LanguageData.LP_FeatGrowth.description: Hand of Harvest feat: all plants within 6 cells of you gain +20% growth (up to mature). Once per day, restored at midnight.
LanguageData.LP_FeatFabricate.label: fabricate
LanguageData.LP_FeatFabricate.description: Hands of Creation feat: press while crafting at a workbench to instantly finish half the remaining work (up to the equivalent of 60000 work); this piece's quality is at least "excellent". Does not interrupt the current bill. Once per day, restored at midnight.
